auditor: Gaveglio Aparicio y Asociados Sociedad Civil de Responsabilidad Limitada, member firm of PricewaterhouseCoopers International Limited
detail: The independent auditors' report on the Banco Central de Reserva del Peru's financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2024, addressed to the bank's directors, is signed at Lima on 28 February 2025 by Gaveglio Aparicio y Asociados, countersigned by partner Cecilia Hashimoto. The report's own footer states that Gaveglio Aparicio y Asociados is a member firm of the global PricewaterhouseCoopers International Limited network and a separate legal entity.
source_title: Memoria 2024, chapter 7: estados financieros e informe de los auditores independientes (Banco Central de Reserva del Peru)

detail: The National Bank of Romania's own annual report for 2019 names KPMG Audit SRL as the external auditor of the bank's financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2019, in the section on the bank's audit committee; the statements themselves state that they were audited by KPMG. The annual report does not reproduce the auditor's signature block, so no signing city or date is recorded here.
